purpose: Fixes one execution-lineage blocker found by independent verification of rc7 (QA_PASSED, chain-valid, session 019ffd88-b735-77c0-ad8d-145ba014751a): implementation.graph.v6.yaml's result_pattern (execution_package_v2/results/{node_id}.result.v1.json) is byte-identical to implementation.graph.v5.yaml's own. N00_SPEC_APPROVAL_GATE and N10_HARNESS_PROTOCOL are already ADMITTED (PASSED) and N20_PROVIDER_TRANSPORT is already BLOCKED (finding N20V2-F01), all three with real results at that exact shared path. Because graph v6 genuinely rebound N00's prompt/schema, the already-admitted N00 result's recorded prompt_sha256 no longer matches the live prompt v6 file -- validate_result_v2.py --node N00_SPEC_APPROVAL_GATE against graph v6 as originally built genuinely returns a prompt-hash-mismatch error. Re-executing any of N00, N10, or N20 under graph v6 would have written its fresh result to the exact same path as the existing admitted/blocked record, silently overwriting it. This snapshot deprecates implementation.graph.v6.yaml properly (preserved byte-for-byte at deprecated/implementation.graph.v6.yaml) and introduces implementation.graph.v7.yaml with result_pattern (and every node's own result/evidence write paths) moved to the versioned subdirectory execution_package_v2/results/v7/, whose per-node filenames never coincide with the flat per-node files directly under execution_package_v2/results/. schemas/spec_approval.schema.v4.json and contracts/spec_approval.v4.yaml carry forward rc3's already-approved digests and model assignments unchanged, updated only for the new graph's path/digest and schema version. The three v7 prompts are mechanical gate-lineage renames of their v6 predecessors. controller/scan_node.py's DEFAULT_GRAPH_PATH and both tools/validate_*.py modules' own graph/schema/contract/result-prefix bindings move to this generation's own artifacts, the same per-generation hardcoded-binding discipline used since v1 -- tools/validate_result_v2.py deliberately keeps its no-flag, single-graph-binding design (see its own updated module docstring). tests/test_execution_package_v2.py gains a dedicated RC8 collision/preservation section (175 tests total, 14 more than rc7's 161). No production file and no N00/N10/N20 result was touched.

corrects_prior_generation_finding.note: rc7 itself reached QA_PASSED and is not reopened, edited, or overridden -- this is not a QA failure being corrected, but a defect found by independent verification performed after rc7 passed, outside rc7's own QA criteria's scope (rc7's criteria correctly reviewed the two rc6 findings it existed to fix, RC6-QA-001 and RC6-QA-002, and did not examine result_pattern collision across graph generations). rc1 through rc7 in full (including each one's QA/ session) are preserved exactly as they were and are not reopened, edited, or overridden by this snapshot.

findings_fixed.title: implementation.graph.v6.yaml's result_pattern collides with the admitted/blocked N00/N10/N20 records' actual paths
findings_fixed.fix: Deprecated implementation.graph.v6.yaml properly (preserved byte-for-byte at deprecated/implementation.graph.v6.yaml, sha256 unchanged). Introduced implementation.graph.v7.yaml with result_pattern and every node's own result-write/evidence-root writes entries moved to execution_package_v2/results/v7/. Introduced schema v4, contract v4, and a v7 prompt set as mechanical consequences. Updated controller/scan_node.py's DEFAULT_GRAPH_PATH and both tools/validate_*.py modules' own bindings to graph v7 / schema v4 / contract v4 / results/v7/. Added a dedicated RC8 test section proving the collision cannot recur and every prior artifact remains byte-unchanged.

source_note: Every file below other than deprecated/implementation.graph.v6.yaml (immutable historical content, unchanged since rc7's own approval) is byte-identical to the live package-v2 file at the same relative path at snapshot time, reconfirmed immediately before this snapshot was taken: `python3 -m pytest -q plans/27_langgraph_curriculum_factory_remediation/execution_package_v2/tests/test_execution_package_v2.py` -> 175 passed; `python3 plans/27_langgraph_curriculum_factory_remediation/execution_package_v2/tools/validate_plan_v2.py` -> valid: true.
reviewed_artifact_note: The single file submitted to qa-gate-codex-run as --artifact. It embeds the full verbatim text of every file under review, generated by a deterministic script (not hand-authored) that re-verifies each section's extracted SHA-256 against the live file's SHA-256 before writing the bundle to disk -- the same discipline rc7 introduced to fix RC6-QA-001. deprecated/implementation.graph.v6.yaml is genuinely static historical content, not logic under review, and is embedded in the bundle for its own byte-identity check rather than supplied separately as --ground, since its exact bytes are directly relevant to RC8-T01/T04's substance-comparison criteria.
deterministic_validation_note: controller/scan_node.py, tools/validate_plan_v2.py, tools/validate_result_v2.py, and tests/test_execution_package_v2.py bind to their own absolute repo-relative path (Path(__file__).resolve() arithmetic), unchanged since rc1. A byte-identical copy placed under release_candidate/rc8/ therefore cannot be independently re-executed in place, exactly as every prior generation confirmed. Behavioral identity is established by SHA-256 equality against the live plans/27_.../execution_package_v2/ files (below), reconfirmed passing immediately before this snapshot was taken (see source_note).
